Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back! The Lankan players are on the field. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney are the openers for Australia Women. The latter will be hoping to strike some form this evening. Sugandika Kumari to begin proceedings...
... CHASE BEGINS ...
Right then, a low score again in front of Australia Women and let's see how they approach. There will be spin, so they have to be careful. Stay tuned.

Grace Harris (3-0-7-2) comes up for a quick interview. Says that the pitch is pretty outstanding and she tried to give it a good rip. Shares that Meg Lanning advised her to pull the length back as the batters were looking to use their feet. On her outstanding catch to dismiss Chamari Athapaththu, she replies that she just committed herself to that catch and it went well. She is backing the batting unit to chase down this total and her advice is to use the footwork smartly.

Sri Lanka Women started decently in the Powerplay and scored 38 runs but failed to capitalize on the start. After the departure of Chamari Athapaththu, the scoring rate nosedived and the set batter Harshitha Madavi struggled to score freely. Meg Lanning unleashed an army of spin bowlers and everyone contributed to the cause. 13 overs were bowled by the Aussie spinners and they all were very economical. Megan Schutt bowled at the death and finished with a 4-wicket haul.

Yet another fine bowling show from Australia Women!​​​​ They were right on the money, especially after the Powerplay and choked the flow of runs completely. The Lankan batters struggled to find the boundaries and the pressure started to mount. Towards the end, they tried to go big but kept on losing the wickets. The end result is just 112 runs on the board.

OUT! Third stumping for Alyssa Healy!​ Megan Schutt fires across a length ball outside off, Sugandika Kumari skips down the track for a big shot down the ground but misses. Healy fumbles to collect the ball on the first attempt but then recovers quickly to inflict a stumping. The finger is raised and Sri Lanka Women end on 112 for 8.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: On a length around the pads, Sugandika Kumari looks to glance but gets hit on the pads. No run taken.
FOUR! Full and around off, Sugandika Kumari hammers it aerially and down to long off. The fielder tries her best, running across from long on, but fails to keep it in.
Sugandika Kumari is in next. Nilakshi de Silva is stranded at the other end.

OUT! STUMPED! Megan dishes it out on a length and outside off, Malsha tries to heave across the line but misses. Healy collects the ball and breaks the stumps. She appeals and then goes to celebrate. The third umpire is referred. First, she checks for the outside edge which is absent. The side-on angle shows that Malsha Shehani's back leg is on the line and there is nothing behind.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Malsha Shehani is in next. Immediately there is an appeal for stumping. The third umpire is referred.

OUT! CAUGHT! Megan Schutt gets her second wicket. Serves it on a length, around middle and leg, Ama Kanchana tries to slog but it takes the top edge and flies towards point. It's a simple catch for Beth Mooney.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery around middle, Ama Kanchana hit this off the toe end of her bat straight down the ground towards long on for a couple of runs.
Yorker around middle, Ama Kanchana digs it out to the leg side and takes a quick run. Alyssa Healy has a shy at the bowler's end but hits Ama instead.
Flighted delivery around pads, Ama Kanchana looks to sweep but fails to connect properly.
Fantastic stroke for three runs here from the bat of Nilakshi de Silva. Tossed up around off, Nilakshi de Silva lofts this over the infield at mid off.
Flighted around off, Ama Kanchana looks to sweep but misses out. Gets a deflection of her ribs and takes a single towards short third man. Given as a leg bye.
Tossed-up around off, Nilakshi de Silva shuffles across and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Put away! Nilakshi de Silva is getting some crucial boundaries here. Poor delivery, full and down the leg side, Nilakshi de Silva gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards long leg for a boundary. 100 comes up!
Change in bowling.  Alana King to bowl her last over.
Ends the over with a single. Flatter and shorter, around off, it's worked through square leg for a run. Nilakshi de Silva wants the second run but is sent back.
Length delivery angling in on stumps, Ama Kanchana works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nearly another wicket for Megan Schutt. Leg-cutter getting the better of Ama Kanchana as she goes fishing outside off but gets beaten.
Ama Kanchana is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. Length delivery angling into the batter, following Vishmi Gunaratne down the leg side who attempts to heave but it comes off from the inner part of her bat. The ball flies to deep mid-wicket and Ellyse Perry runs forward to complete the catch with a slide.
Commentary.Howout: c Ellyse Perry b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery outside off, Nilakshi de Silva has tucked this fine for a single towards deep fine leg.
Length delivery on off, Vishmi Gunaratne pushes this towards deep square leg for a single.
Megan Schutt comes back into the attack. None for 14 from her two overs so far.
FOUR! Sri Lanka Women will hope for many more from her bat. Tossed up, full and around off, Nilakshi de Silva kneels down and muscles her sweep shot to the deep square leg fence.
On a length in middle, Vishmi Gunaratne has flicked this for a single towards square leg.
Flatter one on top of middle, Nilakshi de Silva has nudged this in front of square for a single.
Nilakshi de Silva is the new batter.

OUT! Drags it on! Georgia Wareham gets her first wicket of the game. She gives it some extra air and lands it full and outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani shimmies down the track and tries to drive but it takes the inner edge and cannons onto the stumps. It continues to go downhill for Sri Lanka Women.
Fuller delivery around off, Vishmi Gunaratne has swept this towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Wide down the leg. Vishmi Gunaratne looks to flick but misses out.
Tossed up around pads, Vishmi Gunaratne has glanced this towards deep square leg for a couple.
Georgia Wareham is into her final over.
Alana King ends with a dot. Quicker one outside off, Anushka Sanjeewani looks to poke at it but misses out.
Fuller on around the pads, Vishmi Gunaratne has pushed this towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on her pads, Anushka Sanjeewani has clipped this fine towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Sri Lanka Women! Flighted and full, down the leg side, Anushka Sanjeewani goes down and sweeps it powerfully through square leg for a boundary.

Doesn't carry! Loopy and full, around off, Anushka Sanjeewani walks forward and plays a mistimed lofted shot towards mid off. Tahlia McGrath first runs back and then tries to go across to her right to take the catch. She dives but it falls short. They get two runs.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Vishmi Gunaratne walks at it to flick but gets a leading edge to mid off for a single.
Full and floated, down the leg side again, Anushka Sanjeewani tries to sweep it but ends up gloving it down.
Wide! Flighted delivery down the leg side, Anushka Sanjeewani tries to flick but misses.
Full and around leg, helped softly to mid-wicket for one.
Loopy and full, down the leg side, Anushka sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Very full and on off, driven to mid off.
Beaten! Flighted and just outside off, spinning away, Anushka Sanjeewani tries to defend but misses.
Flighted around leg, it's clipped to square leg for a single.
Anushka Sanjeewani walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in the over for Oshadi Ranasinghe. Flighted delivery, landing full around middle, Oshadi Ranasinghe tries to heave it across the line but ends up hitting it a lot straighter without much timing. Tahlia McGrath makes no mistake at long on and the Sri Lankan inning is going nowhere at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Grace Harris

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! The batter swings hard at that one but does not connect.
Play and a miss! Tossed up, around off, Oshadi tries to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Flatter and on middle, Oshadi Ranasinghe defends it off the outer edge.
Oshadi Ranasinghe walks in next

OUT! STUMPED! The pressure was building and Harshitha Madavi succumbs to it. A lovely delivery. Floated and full, drifting around off, Harshitha Madavi jumps down the track for a big shot but it spins away late to beat his bat. Alyssa Healy calmly takes the bails off and Sri Lanka Women lose their second wicket. End of an unconvincing knock by Madavi.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Grace Harris

Commentary.Commentary: Walks forward and flicks a full ball to mid-wicket for a single.
Grace Harris is back on. 0 for 6 in her two overs so far.
Full and floated, around off, Madavi tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the boot.
Quicker and fuller, around leg, Madavi tries to sweep but misses.

It's through everyone! Floated leg spinner, landing around off, Harshitha Madavi advances down the track, trying to heave but it spins past the inside edge. Alyssa Healy has no chance to collect it and the ball goes to fine leg. They get a couple of byes.
Flighted delivery, full and landing around off, Madavi forces it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up, around off, Vishmi Gunaratne gets back and helps it towards square leg for one.
Fuller and around leg, Madavi sweeps it over square leg for a single. Sri Lanka Women need boundaries.
Georgia Wareham is back on. 0 for 2 in her one over so far.

Given lbw! Vishmi Gunaratne has a word with her partner and then decides to review the decision. King gives it some extra flight and lands it full around leg, Vishmi goes down to play the reverse sweep but fails to connect. She is rapped on the pads, they appeal and this time the umpire agrees. DRS time. Nothing on the UltraEdge. Time for the Ball Tracking - it's pitching in line, the impact is with the umpire's call but it's MISSING THE STUMPS. The onfield decision has been overturned.
Aerial but safe. Flighted and around leg, Harshitha Madavi sweeps it aerially over square leg. Megan Schutt comes running in from the deep but it falls in front of her. They cross.
Flighted delivery, around off and a bit on the shorter side, Madavi gets back and defends it down.
Too full and on middle, it's driven down the ground to long on, for a single.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Tossed up, full and landing around leg, Vishmi jumps down the track and then tries to sweep but misses. It goes off her pads to fine leg and they collect a couple of leg byes. No DRS taken again.
Flighted and full, around off, Harshitha Madavi gets down and sweeps it to deep square leg for a run. Very slow going from Sri Lanka Women.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it calmly towards short cover.
Goes down on one knee and plays the conventional sweep. Sends the ball to deep square leg and collects a single.
Loopy and around off, fuller in length, Madavi tries to play the reverse sweep but scuffs her shot to the keeper's left.
Tossed up around off, Vishmi Gunaratne goes down and paddles it to fine leg for a single.
Advances down the track and almost yorks herself. Vishmi Gunaratne somehow digs it out to mid-wicket.
Short in length and outside off, Harshita gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks break. Sri Lanka Women have started solidly but now they need to step on the gas. Australia Women have not picked wickets but they have pulled back the scoring rate. The next phase is going to be crucial for both sides. Can Australia Women maintain a tight grip on the scoring or will Sri Lanka Women start to score freely?
Quicker one through the air, Vishmi Gunaratne gets an outside edge as the fielder at point gathers this.
Flighted delivery outside off, Vishmi Gunaratne defends it towards point.
Beauty by Alana King as it grips and bounces into the hands of the keeper. Vishmi Gunaratne gets beaten to the flight of it as she tries to defend the off-stump line.
Full and around off, Madavi shuffles across and sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Harshitha Madavi has pushed this towards covers.

Stifled appeal for an lbw! Quicker and fuller, around off, Madavi goes down to sweep and perhaps gets an inner edge. It touches her pads and rolls away to short fine leg. Meg Lanning decides not to review it. The replays confirm there was an inside edge.
Alana King to bowl her leggies.
Flatter around middle, Harshitha Madavi has nudged this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length dragged back a bit here by Grace Harris, Vishmi Gunaratne has tucked this well with softer hands towards the vacant mid on region for a single.
Tossed-up delivery on her pads, Harshitha Madavi has swept this well towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch fuller around off, Harshitha Madavi has punched this towards short extra cover.
Flighted around off, defended to covers.
Flighted outside off, Harshitha Madavi has blocked this out with a forward defensive stroke.
Change in bowling. Grace Harris is ready to bowl now.
Fuller one drifting down the pads, Vishmi Gunaratne gets beaten as the ball strikes her pads. Another appeal but not convincing enough.

Shout for an lbw! The finger stays down. Flighted delivery, around middle and leg and there is some extra bounce. Vishmi gets back to work it on the leg side but misses. She is rapped on the pads but nothing doing. Australia Women decide not to review.
Leg break turning away from the right-hander, Vishmi Gunaratne has blocked this out of the back foot.
Flighted delivery around middle, Vishmi Gunaratne gets a leading edge towards short third man as she attempts to flick.
Quicker one on a length around off, Harshitha Madavi has pushed this towards the sweeper cover for a single.
Loopy delivery down the leg side, Vishmi Gunaratne gets some gloves to it as the ball travels to the fielder at short fine leg. Single taken.
Georgia Wareham comes into the attack now. She was the Player of the Match in the last game against Bangladesh Women.
On a length around the pads, Vishmi Gunaratne has worked this towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Gets it fine and away to the fence. Perry delivers it on a length, around leg and angling down, Vishmi Gunaratne gets some tickle behind the ball and it races away to the fine leg fence.
Short and outside off, Way too wide for the umpire's liking.
Short and wide outside off, Harshitha Madavi cuts this towards third man for a single.
Overpitched delivery outside off, Harshitha Madavi has driven this straight to the fielder at short cover.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Short in length and around off, Harshitha Madavi gets on top of the bounce, swivels on the back foot and pulls it delightfully through backward square leg. She has some swagger about her batting.
Fuller one in the middle, Vishmi Gunaratne has flicked this towards deep square leg for a single.
Powerplay is done. Losing Chamari Athapaththu is a big loss but Sri Lanka Women have fared decently so far in the game. Ellyse Perry to bowl her second over on the trot.
Back of a length on and around off, Vishmi Gunaratne nudges this towards square leg for a single. 38 for 1 in the Powerplay.
Length delivery on top of middle, Harshitha Madavi has tucked this away towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Harshitha Madavi loves playing this shot. Fuller in length, around off, she shuffles across the stumps and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Length delivery on the stumps, Harshitha Madavi has pushed this towards mid on.
Length delivery just outside off, Vishmi Gunaratne gets a thickish inside edge as it runs towards fine leg for a single.
On a length shaping in towards the batter, Vishmi Gunaratne has blocked this out from the inner edge of her bat.
Megan Schutt to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Shortish and angling down the leg side, it's tucked behind square leg for one. End of a successful over from Perry.

OUT! CAUGHT! Grace Harris has pulled off an absolute blinder. It's a massive breakthrough as well, as the prolific run-scorer of Sri Lanka Women is on her way back. Ellyse Perry lands it on a length, around middle and off, Chamari Athapaththu runs down the track for a big shot but mistimes her aerial shot behind the bowler. Grace Harris, stationed at mid on, reacts to her right, covers a lot of ground and then puts in a dive to complete a stunning catch. Well done! Vishmi Gunaratne is the new batter.
Commentary.Howout: c Grace Harris b Ellyse Perry

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length around middle, Chamari Athapaththu stays back and defends it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Short again, wide outside off, Harshitha Madavi reaches out and chops it down to third man. They take a single.
A touch short and outside off, angling away, Madavi stays back and guides it to point.
Back of a length, around off, Madavi turns and pulls but finds short mid-wicket.
Ellyse Perry comes into the attack.
Fires it flat and short around middle and leg, Chamari goes back and defends it on the leg side. 8 from the over!

SIX! Here comes the first maximum of the game. Extra flight this time, full and around off, Chamari Athapaththu gets the chance to get inside the line of this delivery and launches it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter again, short and on off, punched back to the bowler.
Flatter this time, a touch shorter around leg, Chamari hangs back to flick but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Loopy and full, around off, Madavi sweeps it to deep square leg for one.

Aerial but safe! Lucky for the Lankan skipper. Ashleigh Gardner fires it full and around leg, Chamari Athapaththu goes down for the slog sweep but gets a top edge. It flies behind the keeper and they cross.
Ashleigh Gardner is back on.
Full and around leg, Chamari tickles it in front of square on the leg side and steals a quick run. It's a confident start from Sri Lanka Women.
Wide! Megan Schutt loses her line and slips a length ball down the leg side, Chamari swings her bat but fails to connect. A good take by Alyssa Healy.
Another dot. Length delivery, around middle, Chamari brings her bat down in time and defends it to cover-point.
Slower one, on a good length around leg. Chamari Athapaththu walks forward to flick but misses as there is some extra bounce. She is hit on the thigh pad.
Back of a length, around off and angling away, Harshita rocks back to cut but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man. They cross.
Another couple. Full and down the leg side, it's flicked over backward square leg. Alana King does well in the deep to stop the racing ball.
Up and over! Schutt begins with a fuller one, around off and slower in pace, Harshitha Madavi tries to flick across the line but gets a leading edge over backward point. They get two runs.
Megan Schutt comes into the attack.
Beaten! Slower one, on a length and outside off, Chamari pushes at it and misses. It goes on one bounce to Alyssa Healy. Good start from Chamari Athapaththu!
FOUR! Another delightful shot from the Lankan skipper. Brown pitches it up and offers plenty of width, Chamari Athapaththu attacks it and drives it crisply through cover-point.
Fullish and around leg, it's clipped straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! The Sri Lankan skipper is off the mark. Fuller and on off, Chamari Athapaththu latches onto it and drills it through the gap at extra cover for a cracking boundary.
Play and a miss! Brown goes full and wide outside off, just inside the  tramline, Chamari chases and misses.
Lands it on a length around middle and off, Chamari Athapaththu gets forward and defends it near her front pad.
Who will bowl from the opposite end? It's Darcie Brown.
Nearly another boundary. Short in length and outside off, spinning away, Madavi cuts but fails to beat the point fielder.
Shortish and on off, some extra bounce, Madavi goes back and plays it down to point.
FOUR! Here comes the first boundary of the game. Fuller and around off, Harshitha Madavi is down on one knee in a flash and sweeps it firmly through backward square leg for a boundary.
Floated one, full and drifting around off, Harshitha Madavi presses forward in defense.
Sri Lanka Women are away! Loopy delivery, full and on off, Harshitha Madavi goes down and paddles it down to fine leg. The outfield is heavy and they get a couple of runs.
Begins with a dot. Flighted and around off, skidding in, Madavi defends it off her front foot.

We're done with all the pre-match formalities. The players of Australia Women get into a huddle before spreading on the ground. Chamari Athapaththu and Harshitha Madavi are the openers for Sri Lanka Women.​ Meg Lanning has decided to start with the spin of Ashleigh Gardner. Here we go...
The teams are out for their respective national anthems. The conditions are overcast at the moment and let's hope to get an uninterrupted game.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Harshitha Madavi, Chamari Athapaththu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Nilakshi de Silva, Malsha Shehani (In for Kavisha Dilhari), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Ama Kanchana, Sugandika Kumari, Inoka Ranaweera, Achini Kulasuriya.

Australia Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Grace Harris, Georgia Wareham, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.
TOSS- Australia Women have won the toss and opted to bowl first.

Both the teams have set standards high for themselves but defeating Australia Women in a World Cup game could prove to be a game-changer for the Islanders. They seem to have the bowling package to compete with the Australians and if their batters manage to put up a fight, we can expect a close encounter. Stay tuned for more updates...

Australia Women have steamrolled their opponents so far in the tournament. They have paced up well with two wins out of two against quality sides like New Zealand Women and Bangladesh Women. Meg Lanning and Alyssa Healy have started off the tournament in fine form along with the all-rounder Ashleigh Gardner who is proving to be handy with both ball and bat in her hands. The inclusion of Georgia Wareham has also been shot in the arm for the Aussies. The form of Beth Mooney though is a concern and the defending champions would hope that she strikes form this evening.

Sri Lanka Women pulled up a surprise in their first game defeating the host nation South Africa Women and then went on to defeat their Asian counterpart in Bangladesh Women convincingly. For Sri Lanka Women, it is the top order that is firing well so far and the bowlers are complementing them fair enough. Though it seems to be seen how they are going to tackle the overwhelming tournament favourites in Australia Women today.

Hello and welcome to all, we are all set for this top-of-the-table clash in Group A with Sri Lanka Women taking on the mighty Australia Women in match number 11 of the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. St. George's Park, Port Elizabeth will host this mouth-watering encounter.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is now time for match number 11 in the Women's T20 World Cup. In this match, Sri Lanka Women will be locking horns against Australia Women. Well, at the start of this campaign I hardly thought that I would be writing the next statement - This battle will be a fiesty clash as two unbeaten side in Group 1 go head-to-head, but boy this Sri Lankan Women's side has proved me wrong. So now only one side will be able to extend their lead in the points table and take a step closer to seal a spot in semi-finals. Sri Lanka Women though need to bring their A-game this time against a solid Australian outfit. 129 - This could be a lucky number for Sri Lanka in this tournament. They have made the same score in both the matches with the blade which has led them to remain unbeaten in this campaign so far. Although, 129 could turn out to be a risky total on the board against this dominating Australian side, for whom this could well be a walk in the park. Australia Women have been lethal with the bat so far in this competition and would continue to do the same going forward. Will Sri Lanka Women be able to suffocate the Australian batting unit? Or will Australia Women extend their winning run? We shall find out together.
